assets.name: 墙体
assets.prompt: Input image role: geometry reference showing existing top-down wall grid blocks. Create ONE SINGLE wall-block tile for ONE 32x32 game grid cell, based on the reference's individual square block. Exact top-down 2D orthographic wall-cap icon, no isometric cube and no perspective. pale lilac top, soft periwinkle rim and muted blue-gray bottom band. Cute cozy gentle cartoon art, simple matte flat colors, clean warm outlines, no spots, no grain, no realistic texture, no glossy candy reflections. Entire image must be filled and completely opaque RGB, including corner pixels outside the slightly rounded cap, where the darker base color fills in. No blank space, transparency, outer margin, shadow cast outside the block, labels, lettering, floor, plants or background scenery. This one square asset will be drawn once per wall grid cell to form horizontal walls, vertical walls and corners. Production asset neon_alley/wall.
